requirement_summary: Unregistered user can see approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without any authentication headers. Verify that the response contains a list of reports where status is 'Resolved' or equivalent approved states, and that no 'Pending Approval' reports are included.
rationale: Validates the core requirement for public visibility of approved reports without authentication.

requirement_summary: Unregistered user can see approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response excludes any reports currently in 'Pending Approval' state, ensuring only fully processed reports are visible.
rationale: Tests the filtering logic to ensure pending reports are hidden from unauthenticated users as per domain rules.

requirement_summary: Unregistered user can see approved reports on an interactive map.
prompt: Execute a GET request to /reports/approved without authentication. Verify that the response returns a 401 Unauthorized status code if the endpoint is strictly protected and not public, or confirm that the system correctly handles unauthenticated access as defined in requirements.
rationale: Tests the boundary condition where unauthenticated access might be restricted despite the requirement implying visibility.

requirement_summary: Municipal administrator can configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category.
prompt: Authenticate as a municipal administrator. Execute POST /reports/{id}/auto-assign-officer to assign a report automatically based on its category configuration. Verify that the assignment is successful and the report status changes appropriately.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a new report resource with a specific category
POST /sessions to obtain an authenticated session for municipal_administrator
cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports/{id}/delete if it exists; otherwise, verify no resource was created.
rationale: Validates the automatic assignment functionality configured by administrators.

requirement_summary: Municipal public relations officer can review and approve or reject reports.
prompt: Authenticate as a municipal public relations officer. Execute PUT /reports/{id}/mainteiner to assign a report to an external maintainer for review. Verify that the assignment is successful and the report status reflects the new state.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a new report resource
POST /sessions to obtain an authenticated session for municipal_public_relations_officer
cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports/{id}/delete if it exists; otherwise, verify no resource was created.
rationale: Validates the ability of PR officers to assign reports for review.

requirement_summary: Technical office staff member can assign reports to external maintainers.
prompt: Authenticate as a technical office staff member. Execute POST /reports/{id}/auto-assign-maintainer to automatically assign a report to an external maintainer based on category configuration. Verify that the assignment is successful and the report status changes appropriately.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a new report resource with a specific category
POST /sessions to obtain an authenticated session for technical_office_staff
cleanup_strategy: DELETE the created report via POST /reports/{id}/delete if it exists; otherwise, verify no resource was created.
rationale: Validates the automatic assignment functionality configured by administrators.

requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to register with my name and username So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
prompt: Execute registration for a new citizen user. Provide valid name, unique username, and mandatory email address. Verify response indicates successful account creation or appropriate error if duplicate username/email is detected.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates the entry point for user onboarding and ensures data integrity during initial account creation.

requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to confirm my registration with a code So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
prompt: Simulate email verification flow. First, trigger code generation via /citizens/verification-code (authenticated). Then, call /citizens/verify-email with a valid 6-digit code within the 30-minute window. Verify account status updates to 'verified'.
setup_needed: POST /citizens/verification-code to generate a valid code
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Ensures the critical account activation flow works correctly and respects the time-bound nature of verification codes.

requirement_summary: As an external maintainer I want to update the status of a report assigned to me So that I can updated citizens about the intervention.
prompt: Attempt to update the status of a report to 'Resolved' while acting as an external maintainer who does NOT have assignment access to this specific report. Verify the system denies the transition.
setup_needed: POST /reports to create a report assigned to a different user
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Validates role-based access control (RBAC) prevents unauthorized status changes.

requirement_summary: System administrator sets up municipality users.
prompt: Create a new municipality user with valid email, password, and role 'municipality_user'. Verify response includes created user ID and status 201.
setup_needed: Ensure session is active for admin role via /sessions/current
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Validates core user creation functionality required for subsequent role assignment and report management.
